{"metadata":{"description":"Research, create, and understand Path of Exile 2 builds with AI agents and Path of Building.","id":"gh:1296517619","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"poe2-exile-architect","slug":"avdergh/poe2-exile-architect","topics":["ai-agents","codex","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","knowledge-base","mcp","mcp-server","model-context-protocol","opencode","path-of-building","path-of-exile-2","poe2"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Research, create, and understand Path of Exile 2 builds with AI agents and Path of Building."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Exile Architect"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Research, create, and understand Path of Exile 2 builds with your AI agent.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Exile Architect connects Codex, OpenCode, and DeepSeek Harness to Path of Exile 2 game data, a local"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" build knowledge base, and Headless Path of Building (PoB). Your agent makes the design decisions; P"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"oB supplies the calculations and the build checks."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Install · Usage · Showcase · FAQ · Contributing"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Local knowledge base and PoB validation"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Local knowledge base**"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Research turns mechanics, component interactions, and usage conditions from existing builds into res"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"earch records stored on your computer. The knowledge carries across conversations, and Create retrie"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ves relevant records when designing a new build, reusing earlier research."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Local execution**"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Game data queries, knowledge storage, and PoB calculations run on your machine, and build files are "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"saved locally. The model uses your agent host's existing configuration; whether online research and "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"model calls use remote services depends on the task and host settings."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **PoB validation**"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The equipment, skills, and passives designed by the agent are written into PoB before damage, defens"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e, and resource data are read back. The numbers correspond to a specific build and combat configurat"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ion and can be checked. Mechanics that PoB does not cover are documented separately, and estimates a"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"re shown separately from calculated results."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Three workflows"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| I want to… | Use | What I get |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Extract useful knowledge from an existing build | **Research** · `poe-bd-research` | Saved explana"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"tions of mechanics, component synergies, requirements, and failure cases that future builds can draw"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" on |
| Design a build for a class, skill, and target level | **Create** · `poe-bd-create` | Skill, "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"equipment, and passive choices; PoB checks; local build files and a playstyle explanation |
| Unders"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"tand how an existing build works | **Learning** · `poe-bd-learn` | An HTML learning guide with compo"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"nent icons, combat-loop diagrams, explanations, navigation, and search |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Research builds the knowledge base. Create uses it to design builds. Learning teaches you a build "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"without adding it to the knowledge base.** You can use each workflow on its own."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Build your own local knowledge base"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Study builds you are interested in with Research and keep the findings for later use. Research saves"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" explanations of skill interactions, equipment roles, passive choices, resource recovery, and defens"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"es, along with their requirements, failure conditions, and game versions. Accepted findings stay on "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"your machine and remain available in future conversations."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"When you ask for a new build, Create searches this knowledge base for research relevant to the class"},{"id":"p20s2","text":", skills, and target version. Your agent uses those findings to make design decisions, assembles a b"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"uild at the requested level, and checks it with PoB. Studying builds in a playstyle you enjoy can gi"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ve future Create requests more mechanics and alternatives to consider."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"For example, research a few Spark builds, then ask Create for a level 90 Spark build using the relat"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ed local research. The saved knowledge informs the new design; its equipment, resource requirements,"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" and calculated performance are checked again for the new build. Missing evidence and unmodelled mec"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"hanics remain explicit in the result."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Exile Architect installs from a source checkout, and your agent starts its tools from that folder — "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"keep it in place after installation."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 1. Install the prerequisites"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Git and uv. uv can install the required Python version for you.
- An agent host: **Codex**, **Open"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"Code**, or **DeepSeek Harness**, with model access already configured. Research requires a host that"},{"id":"p25s3","text":" gives subagents access to MCP tools.
- **LuaJIT 2.1**, used to run the PoB calculation engine:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| System | LuaJIT installation |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Windows | Install MSYS2, open its **UCRT64** terminal, and run `pacman -S mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-lu"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ajit`. The standard `C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin\luajit.exe` location is detected automatically. |
| macOS "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"| With Homebrew installed, run `brew install luajit`. |
| Ubuntu / Debian | Run `sudo apt-get update"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"` followed by `sudo apt-get install luajit`. |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"For a nonstandard LuaJIT location, set `POB_LUAJIT` to the executable's absolute path in the environ"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ment used by your agent host. Node.js 20+ is optional, for Build Planner `.build` export."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 2.
